# uring-http-kit

> uring-http-kit: single-thread io_uring HTTP/1.1 kit with a pure-Rust read-only
> SQLite reader (mmap B-tree + WAL frames). Built for the arjaythedev $12 Server
> Challenge; five JSON endpoints, one CPU core, writes via rusqlite.

- Spec: docs/SPEC.md (REQ-URIK-*, tier k, DRAFT)
- Decisions: docs/adr/0001-pure-rust-reader, 0002-backward-walk-feed,
  0003-single-thread-pass-model, 0004-writes-via-rusqlite
- Crates: sqlite-btree (decoders + reader, no_std), uring-http (loop/parser/json),
  feed-server (bin)
- Verification: Lean proofs (proof/), proptest oracles, differential query suite,
  challenge conformance (test/test.sh), bench ladder (bench/)

# fast-track

- decode: crates/sqlite-btree/src/varint.rs, record.rs
- read: crates/sqlite-btree/src/page.rs, btree.rs, wal.rs, pagestore.rs (planned)
- serve: crates/uring-http/src/loop_.rs, http.rs, json.rs
- endpoints: server/src/handlers.rs, store.rs (planned)
